title: Where B-2 Pilots Sleep on a 44-Hour Mission
asof: Figures from the 2001 and 2025 missions · full video on the channel

shots.s: This is the bed on a forty-four-hour bomber mission.
The B-2 flies with just two pilots.
No backup crew. Nobody to swap in.
In 2001, two pilots flew one for forty-four point three hours.
Behind their seats: a modified Army cot and a sleeping bag.
One sleeps while the other flies.
Today, the Air Force says pilots nap on a metal surface back there.
Both must be awake for every air refueling.
The pilot said it wasn't high-quality sleep.
But at that point, any sleep is good sleep.
Could you sleep behind the pilot's seat?
